subject: Predict species detection from occuMulti for categorical covariate

messages.author: c64abac46f6443ee
messages.subject: Predict species detection from occuMulti for categorical covariate
parts:
Hi everyone,

Sorry if this question was already answered elsewhere, but I couldn't find it.

I am fitting multi-species occupancy models using occuMulti, and I have modeled species detection using a categorical covariate with three levels. I know I can use predict() to estimate a species detection modeled by a continuous covariate, but not sure how to proceed for a categorical covariate. How do I predict detection for each category of the covariate?

Thank you so much for any advice!
Cheers,
Ana

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: Predict species detection from occuMulti for categorical covariate
parts:
Hi Ana,

Make a data frame containing a column with each level of the categorical covariate, e.g. if your original categorical covariate is X:

df <- data.frame(x = factor(x, levels=levels(x)))

If you have other covariates in the detection model put them in the data frame at their means or medians. Then supply the data frame to the newdata argument.

predict(model, "det", newdata=df)

Ken
